content.short: MO:ME:NT turns moments of public interest into NFTs via a fully automated API trigger.
content.description: MO:ME:NT links the real world with the Metaverse by making it easy to access virtual spaces through real moments. It converts moments of public interest into MO:ME:NT NFTs, generated automatically by an API trigger that fires when those moments occur. The MO:ME:NT NFTs are endorsed and enriched by the people behind them, and you can buy, own, collect, and trade these tokens. The project runs across Polygon, Solana, and Ethereum to bring tangible moments into crypto collectibles.
